capabilities.name: research_run
capabilities.description: Start a QuantScript research draft as a forge job and return at once. Freezes the engine, the draft's library and the market data, then runs the full native Gauntlet with walk-forward optimization (kind gauntlet) or the native system backtests (kind profit). Poll quantsuite.script.research_read and forge_jobs. One forge job runs at a time. The answer, research_list and research_read carry report_html, the standalone HTML report's file; when the run is done (report_ready true), give the user that path. The report also opens in QuantScript → Forge → Research.

capabilities.name: research_gauntlet_overview
capabilities.description: Report tool 1/4: the Gauntlet report of the active library's existing native evidence, without re-testing. Per indicator: Standard and selected-per-track verdicts on 1h/4h/1d, worst-track overall score, p-values, five axes, walk-forward, parameters, CSV export. Creates a research run and starts it as a forge job; returns the run id at once. The answer, research_list and research_read carry report_html, the standalone HTML report's file; when the run is done (report_ready true), give the user that path. Poll quantsuite.script.research_read; the English report also opens in QuantScript → Forge → Research.

indicators.description: Base indicator keys to include; omit for the whole library.

capabilities.name: research_profit_overview
capabilities.description: Report tool 2/4: the most profitable single indicators and aggregates (2+ distinct base indicators) in a saved QuantSystems system, ranked by final capital against its current setup. Bulk evaluation identical to the native engine; every shown candidate is re-run natively. Report: rankings, capital curves, profit vs drawdown, annual returns, method. Creates a research run and starts it as a forge job; returns the run id at once. The answer, research_list and research_read carry report_html, the standalone HTML report's file; when the run is done (report_ready true), give the user that path. The report also opens in QuantScript → Forge → Research. Large libraries take a while (signals per indicator and pair); poll quantsuite.script.research_read and forge_jobs.

config.description: An explicit system config instead of a saved system.

sizes.description: Aggregate sizes to test; omit for 2 up to all bases.

capabilities.name: research_aggregate_comparison
capabilities.description: Report tool 3/4: a variable-size aggregate search in a saved QuantSystems system, robust by default (docs/ROBUSTNESS.md): only indicators that pass the Indicator Gauntlet on the system's track under the current evaluation; every candidate scored by its WORST price world (saved candles, ±0.03% noise, another exchange, one day of delay) on a search window; its leaders confirmed on the blind years after it against random aggregates of the same size; the System Gauntlet on the best finalists. Only robust finalists are results to save as systems. pool='all' searches every indicator for research only; nothing of it counts as robust. Stages fixed before results: all pairs, growth by size, a small random sample, then local search until stable or the budget (default 5,000,000) ends. Creates a research run and starts it as a forge job; returns the run id at once. The answer, research_list and research_read carry report_html; when the run is done (report_ready true), give the user that path. The report also opens in QuantScript → Forge → Research.

system.description: A saved system's name or id (QuantSystems).

config.description: An explicit system config instead of a saved system.

indicators.description: Candidate keys; omit for each indicator's general version and its version for the system's track (1d for a daily system); Standard only for an indicator without any optimized version.

restarts.description: Later start dates for independent runs (default 2023-01-01, 2025-01-01).

pool.description: robust (default): only indicators certified under the current Gauntlet; all: research only, never robust.

blind_days.description: Days at the end the search never sees (default 730; a third of a shorter history).

gauntlet_top.description: Walk-forward passers checked with the System Gauntlet (default 3).

venues.description: Other-exchange chain for the venue world (default okx, bybit, kucoin, coinbase; never binance, gate, mexc).

capabilities.name: research_robustness
capabilities.description: Report tool 4/4: the System Gauntlet (docs/ROBUSTNESS.md) on a saved QuantSystems system or an explicit config — required before a backtest result is trusted, saved or traded. Six axes, each variant a native engine run on the frozen saved data, scored by the share of the base CAGR it keeps: parameters (member parameters ±15%, members left out or added, top N and market-filter lengths), time (later starts, eras, worst rolling two years), exchange (±0.03% candle noise, another exchange's candles), assets (top N ±2, without the largest coin), Monte Carlo (shuffled-days luck test, return bootstrap with 1- and 3-year loss risk) and execution (one-day delay, 2× fee). Verdict: robust, not robust (failed gates listed) or incomplete. fast=true is a quicker, coarser check. Creates a research run and starts it as a forge job; returns the run id at once. research_list carries each run's verdict; report_html is the standalone report, also shown in QuantScript → Forge → Research; the verdict shows in QuantSystems.

capabilities.description: Forge jobs with status, progress, errors and verdict summaries; detail = a job id returns that job's full event list.

detail.description: A job id from this list.

capabilities.name: forge_cancel
capabilities.description: Cancel the running forge job and its worker processes. A cancelled research run stays visible as interrupted with its partial evidence.

capabilities.name: forge_info
capabilities.description: The forge's market data shelf, its saved reports and the certification tracks.

refresh.description: Re-read the vault instead of the cached listing.

capabilities.name: forge_run
capabilities.description: Start a forge job on the active library: gauntlet, optimize, walkforward, compare or refresh (market data). For new indicators use quantsuite.script.research_create and research_run instead. Certification needs the full protocol; fast is a smoke test only.

resume.description: optimize only: skip indicators whose versions are current.

capabilities.name: list_indicators
capabilities.description: Every indicator version QuantAlgo can use, with its per-track and overall Gauntlet verdicts. Refresh after quantsuite.script.research_install.

refresh.description: Re-read the registry instead of the cache.

capabilities.name: create_strategy_from_indicator
capabilities.description: Create a QuantAlgo strategy from an installed indicator version with its tested parameters. Creates no bot and starts nothing.

params.description: Optional parameter overrides, checked against the indicator's schema.

capabilities.name: manual_runs
capabilities.description: The Manual execution runs of a saved QuantSystems system, newest first (PLAN-AUTO-EXECUTION §2.3): close date, decision, route, guard results, orders with fills, cost, status and a one-line summary.

capabilities.name: manual_arm
capabilities.description: Arm Live Manual execution of a system: from its next run it TRADES REAL MONEY on its account. Refused without a completed paper run, a working account and a robust verdict (or ack_not_robust).

ack_not_robust.description: The user's own "I know this system is not robust".

capabilities.name: manual_disarm
capabilities.description: Disarm Live Manual execution of a system. Nothing is sold.

capabilities.name: stop_all_trading
capabilities.description: "Stop all trading" (PLAN-AUTO-EXECUTION §2.6): on=true stops every bot, disarms every Manual system and cancels QuantSuite's open orders — it never sells, and reports what stays on the exchanges. on=false allows trading again without re-arming or restarting anything.

on.description: true = stop all trading, false = allow it again.

capabilities.name: list_venues
capabilities.description: Every connected exchange account and what it can execute (PLAN-EXECUTION-VENUES): market types, quote asset, whether the execution core can trade on it.

capabilities.name: venue_coverage
capabilities.description: Which of the given coins an account's venue can trade, mapped by verified id (never by name), with the direct pairs between them and the coins it does not list.

symbols.description: Coin symbols, e.g. a system's universe.
